title: Where I've done it
subtitle: Three years of production work - manufacturing systems, internal tooling and my own products, from first requirement to running deployment.

bullets: Built and shipped a fencing product configurator end-to-end - data model, API, calculation logic, UI and deployment. Used daily by 30+ sales representatives and distributors.

Worked as part of an external development team on the extended platform version, including interactive 3D fence visualization: feature and business-logic design, API and data-flow decisions, UX, code contributions, code review and full-stack QA.
Designed and delivered a suite of quoting and BOM tools for photovoltaic structures - adopted across a 20-person division, cutting quote preparation from hours to minutes.
Contributed to a React Native field-inspection application for PV farms - GPS route tracking, photo capture, defect logging and automated reports.
Modelled and implemented the division's end-to-end delivery process in Jira for 40+ users - BPMN, custom workflows, automation rules, Google Drive integration.

Designed, built and operate two production systems end-to-end - architecture, backend, frontend, database schema, cloud services, deployment, tests and UX. One on Java / Spring Boot and React, one on NestJS and Next.js.
Own full production DevOps: Docker Compose, nginx reverse proxy, GitHub Actions CI/CD, self-hosted Linux VPS, S3-compatible object storage, self-hosted analytics.
Delivered client websites on a freelance basis, from requirements through deployment and handover.
Three years of continuous, project-based learning: fullstack development, system design, security and DevOps - every concept validated by shipping something that runs in production.
Polish (native), English (fluent), German (basic). Agile / Scrum, technical communication in both PL and EN.
